nodes.name: Cada día 08:00
nodes.notes: Nota operativa: la hora del cron corre en la TZ del contenedor n8n (America/New_York por defecto — ver PROJECT_STATE.md), NO necesariamente America/Caracas. Ajustar el cron o la variable TZ del contenedor al importar, para que 08:00 sea hora de Caracas de verdad.

parameters.query:
insert into public.daily_metrics (metric_date, new_leads, quotes_created, policies_sold, gross_premium, commissions_accrued, commissions_collected, claims_opened, appointments_scheduled, overdue_amount, messages_processed, escalations_created, llm_tokens_in, llm_tokens_out)
select
  (current_date - 1),
  (select count(*) from public.contacts where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select count(*) from public.quotes where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select count(*) from public.policies where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select coalesce(sum(premium_total),0) from public.policies where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select coalesce(sum(net_amount),0) from public.commissions where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select coalesce(sum(net_amount),0) from public.commissions where status='collected' and collected_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select count(*) from public.claims where reported_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select count(*) from public.appointments where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from public.payments where status = 'overdue'),
  (select count(*) from public.messages where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select count(*) from public.escalations where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select coalesce(sum(llm_tokens_in),0) from public.messages where created_at::date = current_date - 1),
  (select coalesce(sum(llm_tokens_out),0) from public.messages where created_at::date = current_date - 1)
on conflict (metric_date) do update set
  new_leads = excluded.new_leads, quotes_created = excluded.quotes_created, policies_sold = excluded.policies_sold,
  gross_premium = excluded.gross_premium, commissions_accrued = excluded.commissions_accrued,
  commissions_collected = excluded.commissions_collected, claims_opened = excluded.claims_opened,
  appointments_scheduled = excluded.appointments_scheduled, overdue_amount = excluded.overdue_amount,
  messages_processed = excluded.messages_processed, escalations_created = excluded.escalations_created,
  llm_tokens_in = excluded.llm_tokens_in, llm_tokens_out = excluded.llm_tokens_out, computed_at = now()
returning *;

nodes.name: Escalaciones pendientes
nodes.notes: Recoge lo que quedó 'noche + no emergencia' sin notificar en tiempo real (W5) — esto es lo que W5 diseñó para entregar aquí en el digest de las 08:00, ARCHITECTURE.md §Humanidad nocturna.

parameters.query:
select c.name as full_name, a.title, a.starts_at
from public.appointments a join public.contacts c on c.id = a.contact_id
where a.starts_at::date = current_date and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
order by a.starts_at asc;

nodes.name: Armar texto del digest
nodes.notes: Determinista desde SQL, sin LLM. Lee 'Calcular métricas del día anterior' y 'Escalaciones pendientes' por referencia de nodo ($('...')), no por conexión main — evita usar un Merge node para 3 ramas de tamaños distintos (una fila agregada vs N citas), que desalinearía los items. Esas dos ramas quedan como terminales sin conexión de salida; igual se ejecutan al estar conectadas al cron.

nodes.name: Enviar digest (Evolution)
nodes.notes: Migrado de WaAPI a Evolution API v2 el 2026-08-23 (R014). Endpoint /message/sendText/{instancia}, body {number, text} — el número va en dígitos, sin @c.us. Credencial 'Evolution API saliente' (header apikey). JSON.stringify evita romper el body con comillas o saltos de línea.
